correctness.rationale: For the explicitly bounded selfadjoint two-sided diamond Hamiltonian with all four arm couplings nonzero, adjacent hub moments are <A_(j+1),H^2 A_j>=S_j=r_j†l_j and <A_(j+1),H^3 A_j>=(v_j+v_(j+1))S_j+T_j. Identically confined dynamics makes both vanish and forces E_U,j=E_V,j. Conversely orthogonal arm vectors plus equal arm energies yield an exact orthogonal decomposition into 3x3 Jacobi blocks indexed by hubs, proving confinement for all time and compact complete eigenbasis. Taylor amplitudes yield hub-to-hub probabilities |S|² t^4/4 or |conj(r_U)l_U|²|eps_U-eps_V|² t^6/36 according to first failure. Independent Hermitian matrix checks verified 100 finite models, not the infinite operator theorem. Closure of eigenvalue union need not consist solely of eigenvalues.
